text:
Keegan: Hey team — I'm getting a 403 when I try to 'Switch organization' in the console. I can open the org list and projects, but clicking 'Switch' returns permission denied. Screenshot attached.

support_julie: Sorry you're blocked — can you paste the account/org id + browser and whether you're on SSO?

Keegan: Org ID 0xac34, keegan@partnerco.com, Chrome macOS, SSO via Okta. We did an Okta app update yesterday (admin changed scopes).

support_julie: Can you repro with curl and paste the response body & any x-trace-id header? Quick repro helps us triage.

Keegan: Repro curl I used:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $SESSION_TOKEN" \\n  https://console.redwood.com/api/v1/orgs/0xac34/switch\\n```
Response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
X-Trace-Id: tr_01F8YZQ2

{"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing required scope: org:switch","required":"org:switch","provided":["org:read","project:read","billing:read"]}

sre-bot: [audit] 2024-09-14T15:03:10Z user=keegan event=scope_check_failed required=org:switch token_id=tok_7f3c trace=tr_01F8YZQ2

idp_engineer_ron: @keegan thanks — that error string tells us the token never got the org:switch scope. Did the Okta app change remove any scopes or require admin consent?

Keegan: Yes, the Okta admin mentioned they removed some "manage" scopes from the Redwood OAuth app to tighten permissions. Users were asked to re-consent but many didn't.

support_julie: Two paths: 1) quick workaround — generate a short-lived API key from profile (Settings > API keys) and use CLI or API to switch orgs until IDP fix; 2) long-term — IdP admin must re-grant org:switch or update group->role mapping so group membership yields the console role.

idp_engineer_ron: I checked token introspection for the failing token:
```json
{
  "active": true,
  "scope": "openid profile org:read project:read billing:read",
  "sub": "keegan@partnerco.com"
}
```
So indeed org:switch isn't present. Looks like Okta removed the "org:manage" granular scope that maps to org:switch; we need org admin to re-consent to the Redwood app or to add a scope mapping for the group that grants the console role.

maria_pm: For customers hit by this during a change window, we should surface a clear console banner and support doc. Keegan — can you try a private window after re-signing in (clear session) and confirm?

Keegan: Re-signed in, still 403. Trace id now tr_01F8Z0K7. I've opened a ticket with Okta admin to re-consent. Workaround with API key worked to complete the urgent org switch.

support_julie: Thanks — I've escalated to our IdP integrator team and flagged as P2. idp_engineer_ron will push a note to the Okta admin with exact scopes to re-grant and sample group->role mapping. ETA ~4h. In the meantime: (1) use an API key for CLI/API ops, (2) ask Okta admin to re-consent and force users to re-login, (3) clear browser sessions if some users still hit cache.

Keegan: Got it — thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sre-bot: ticket#SUP-8242 assigned -> idp_engineer_ron, priority P2, linked trace tr_01F8YZQ2

support_julie: Follow-up: we'll add a short KB on "Org switch 403 after IdP scope change" with the curl examples and introspection fields to look for.

Keegan: Appreciate it. I'll update the partner Okta admin with the steps.
